name: ai-specview
description: A front end for Claude's questions: each question shows next to the document passage and the code it is about. Ask mode (the ask-mode skill) sends every question of a session there; the spec-elaborate skill writes a spec with you on top of it. In a browser page, or in a pane beside the chat (the -mod skills). Needs the ai-specview binary for the browser page: go install github.com/rrgmc/ai-specview/cmd/ai-specview@latest
